displayName: Automatically creates Windows App shortcuts to desktop
description:
Automatically creates Windows App shortcuts to the desktop to launch resources specified by the IT administrator.

If you enable this policy, Windows App will automatically create desktop shortcuts for resources configured by the IT admin in the Azure Virtual Desktop portal. After the user signs in, these shortcuts will be created on the desktop. When the user signs out, the shortcuts will be automatically cleaned up.

If you disable or do not configure this policy, desktop shortcuts will not be automatically created.
